items.question: How many crew members does JVTO have?
items.answer: JVTO currently operates with 11 active crew members—a mix of guides and drivers based in East Java.

items.question: Do guides speak English?
items.answer: Most JVTO guides are English-speaking. Driver-only roles may be Indonesian-speaking, always paired with an English-speaking escort guide on multi-day routes.

items.question: What is the Dream Team pairing?
items.answer: For multi-day tours, JVTO pairs a dedicated driver (focused on safety, timing, road conditions) with an escort guide (focused on guest briefings, pace, and logistics). This reduces mistakes on long routes.

items.question: Are guides licensed?
items.answer: Yes. JVTO uses licensed local site guides at key locations (Bromo, Ijen, Tumpak Sewu) as required by park and authority regulations, in addition to the escort guide.

items.question: Can I request a specific guide or driver?
items.answer: You can mention a preference when booking via official channels. Crew assignment depends on availability and route requirements. Contact us at WhatsApp +6282244788833 or hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com.
